payload.title: judge_fanout spells 'the seats of a group' (every row but the arbiter's) inline in three functions and re-spells the target_sha normalisation that feedback_store.target_shas owns inside the arbiter-inputs digest, so a change to either fact moves the group tree, the hold and the digest at different times.
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:693-702 (_seat_inputs: its own filter of the arbiter row and its own str(row.get("target_sha") or ""))
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:724-727 (_group_tree: a second inline filter of the arbiter row)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judge_fanout.py:808-813 (arbitration_groups: a third filter, and it then hands the unfiltered by_judge to _group_tree, which filters again)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1714-1717 (target_shas: the owner of how a row's tree is read, with the empty string for none)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/feedback_store.py:1720-1730 (tree_is_mixed documents that a change of the law is a change of this function)
payload.rule_violated: PLAN-v2 section 1.2 one owner per fact; the closing_tree family's own stated contract that a change of the unnamed-tree law is a change of one function (feedback_store.tree_is_mixed).
payload.notes: The digest that binds an arbiter to its seats reads each seat's tree with its own normalisation, and the hold reads it through target_shas. If ARIA-MEDIUM-881 or a later change alters how an unnamed or abbreviated tree is read in the owner, the hold and mint tree move while the digest keeps its old reading (or the reverse), so a re-offer or a stale refusal fires on the wrong event; a new non-seat row kind (a rebuttal or method row) added to one filter and not the others gives three different answers to which rows are seats. Close condition: Add one helper in judge_fanout that returns a group's seat rows and use it in _seat_inputs, _group_tree and arbitration_groups, and have _seat_inputs read each seat's tree through feedback_store.target_shas; pin with a patch test that changing target_shas moves the digest and the hold together. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
